prompt: Create a heartwarming 3D animated cinematic scene inside a cozy vintage hallway. An elderly woman with short white hair, round glasses, a mustard-yellow loose top, beige pants, and slippers playfully poses and dances while an elderly man in a light blue shirt and beige pants crouches nearby, recording her with a smartphone. Warm golden indoor lighting, wooden walls, framed artwork, patterned Persian rug, hanging lamp, cozy home atmosphere. The woman changes playful poses naturally—arms wide, pointing, smiling, raising both hands—while the man moves slightly as he films her. Expressive faces, charming comedic timing, smooth natural body movement, consistent character identity, detailed Pixar-like 3D animation, cinematic depth of field, realistic lighting, warm color grading, smooth camera movement, high detail, 4K.
